summary: Certified the new executable Voice Assistant (taxi + food + navigate intents) end-to-end. 8/8 backend pytest cases pass (/api/voice/prepare for taxi/food/wallet/unknown, auth, empty transcript; /api/voice/transcribe empty-audio 400 + auth gating). Full Playwright run: login → open mic FAB → taxi example chip → prepare returns book_taxi card with pickup='Fort-de-France, Martinique', dropoff='Schoelcher, Martinique', fare=10.10€ → Confirmer la course creates a real ride and navigates to /ride/ride_e2609f5f3cce. Food example chip → book_food card showing 'Sushi Master' (real catalog match) → Commander navigates to /food/merchant_sushi_master. 'Mon portefeuille' example chip → navigate card → /wallet. Confirmation safety verified (no auto-execution; explicit button required; payment_method=cash).
critical_code_review_comments: voice.py is well-structured (~382 lines, below 700-line threshold). Geocode + estimate are awaited concurrently-friendly via asyncio.to_thread. EMERGENT_LLM_KEY required; gracefully falls back to rule-based parser if Claude fails.

Frontend VoiceAssistant.js: data-testid coverage is comprehensive for all phases (input/preparing/action/executing) and action types (taxi/food/navigate). Confirm buttons require explicit click, matching the safety requirement.
Minor: WebSocket warnings (wss://.../api/ws/user_*) are noisy in the console — unrelated to voice feature but worth investigating separately.
Whisper transcribe endpoint correctly returns 400 'Audio vide' for empty payloads and 401 without auth; 25MB cap enforced.
seed_data_creation: Created one real ride (ride_e2609f5f3cce) for famtester via the taxi confirm flow — cash payment, no auto-charge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Voice assistant flows: use EXAMPLE CHIPS (voice-example-Réserve-mo / -Commande-m / -Mon portef) to populate transcript — Web Speech API does NOT work in headless Playwright. Then voice-submit-btn. Confirmations: voice-confirm-taxi-btn creates real ride via /api/rides; voice-confirm-food-btn navigates to /food/{merchantId}; voice-navigate-btn opens INTENT_ROUTE target.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature certified working as designed.
